event_description: Federal Reserve cuts rates by 50bps in emergency response to COVID market stress
outcome_description: SPX rallied briefly then resumed its slide, losing over 20% in the following two weeks as pandemic scale became clear.

event_description: Federal Reserve emergency 100bps rate cut and QE restart as COVID pandemic disrupts global markets
outcome_description: Markets initially sold off another 12% before stabilizing as fiscal stimulus arrived; ultimately marked the reflation bottom.

event_description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 75bps, largest hike since 1994, to combat surging inflation
outcome_description: SPX fell roughly 6% over the following week; growth stocks led the decline as discount rates jumped.

event_description: Federal Reserve delivers fourth consecutive 75bps rate hike, signals higher terminal rate
outcome_description: SPX dropped 2.5% on the day and small-caps underperformed as recession odds re-priced higher.

event_description: Federal Reserve pauses rate hikes for first time in 15 months, holds Fed Funds at 5.25%
outcome_description: Equities finished flat as the hawkish dot plot offset the pause; 2Y yields jumped 10bps.

event_description: Federal Reserve delivers 50bps rate cut, first cut of the easing cycle after inflation cooled
outcome_description: SPX gained 1.7% next session and small-caps outperformed by 200bps; USD softened against DXY basket.

event_description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 25bps and signals possible pause amid banking stress
outcome_description: SPX fell 0.7% while regional banks declined further; short-end yields dropped as cuts were priced in.

event_description: NVIDIA reports Q2 FY24 revenue of $13.5B, doubling YoY on AI GPU demand, guides $16B next quarter
outcome_description: NVDA rose 6% after hours; broader AI infrastructure names (AMD, AVGO, TSMC) rallied 3-5% the next session.

event_description: NVIDIA guides Q1 revenue $11B versus $7B consensus, citing generative AI inflection
outcome_description: NVDA jumped 24% next session, adding $200B in market cap; semiconductor ETF SMH gained 7%.

event_description: NVIDIA reports Q3 FY25 earnings beat but guides Q4 gross margin compression from Blackwell ramp
outcome_description: NVDA fell 2.5% after hours despite beating; semiconductor peers were mixed the following day.

event_description: Apple reports iPhone revenue decline of 10% YoY in Greater China amid Huawei competition
outcome_description: AAPL fell 2% next session; supply chain names in Asia declined 3-5% over the week.

event_description: Apple unveils Vision Pro headset at WWDC, priced at $3499, ships early 2024
outcome_description: AAPL closed roughly flat as investors questioned the addressable market; adjacent VR names traded sideways.

event_description: Google Alphabet Q4 cloud revenue misses expectations, ad growth decelerates
outcome_description: GOOGL fell 7% after hours; other cloud hyperscaler names (MSFT, AMZN) declined 1-2% the next day.

event_description: Google demonstrates Bard AI chatbot with factual error in launch video, ceding ground to Microsoft OpenAI
outcome_description: GOOGL lost $100B in market cap that day (-7.5%); MSFT gained 1.5% on OpenAI investment narrative.

event_description: United Kingdom votes to leave European Union in Brexit referendum
outcome_description: GBP crashed 8% overnight to 30-year lows; FTSE 250 fell 7% next session; global risk assets sold off before recovering within weeks.

event_description: Russia invades Ukraine, launching full-scale military operation
outcome_description: Brent crude spiked above $100, European gas prices doubled; SPX fell 2.5% intraday before recovering; RUB collapsed.

event_description: Hamas attacks Israel triggering war in Gaza, raising Middle East escalation risk
outcome_description: Oil rose 4% Monday; defense stocks (LMT, RTX, NOC) gained 5-10% over the week; gold rallied 3%.

event_description: Iran launches drone and missile attack on Israel, first direct military strike from Iranian soil
outcome_description: Oil opened up 2% Monday but faded as attack was largely intercepted; equities recovered by mid-week.

event_description: OPEC+ announces surprise 1.16 million barrel per day production cut ahead of expectations
outcome_description: Brent gapped up 6% Monday; energy sector (XLE) rose 4%; airlines and transports weakened on cost pressure.

event_description: OPEC+ extends voluntary output cuts of 2.2 million barrels per day through Q2 2024
outcome_description: Brent gained 2% on the announcement but drifted lower over the following weeks as demand concerns dominated.

event_description: Saudi Arabia and Russia launch oil price war, boosting production amid COVID demand collapse
outcome_description: Brent crashed 30% Monday, triggering circuit breakers in US equity futures; energy stocks lost a third of value.

event_description: US announces 25% tariffs on $200B of Chinese imports, escalating trade war
outcome_description: Chinese equities (FXI) fell 2%; industrials and semiconductors underperformed over the following weeks.

event_description: Trump administration announces additional 10% tariffs on remaining $300B of Chinese imports
outcome_description: SPX fell 3% over three sessions; long-duration Treasuries rallied 3% as recession fears mounted.

event_description: US and China agree Phase One trade deal, easing tariff escalation
outcome_description: SPX rose 1% and made fresh highs; industrial metals (copper) gained 2% on cyclical relief.

event_description: Silicon Valley Bank collapses, largest US bank failure since 2008 triggering regional bank crisis
outcome_description: KRE regional bank ETF fell 20% in a week; short-end Treasuries rallied 100bps as market priced Fed cuts.

event_description: First Republic Bank fails and is seized by regulators, sold to JPMorgan Chase
outcome_description: Regional bank stocks fell another 8% over the week; deposit outflows accelerated across mid-size banks.

event_description: Credit Suisse forced merger with UBS at 60% discount amid AT1 bond writedown
outcome_description: European banks fell 5% on Monday open; AT1/CoCo bond market froze temporarily on writedown precedent.

event_description: Meta reports Q4 2021 earnings with first-ever daily active user decline, cuts capex guidance
outcome_description: META lost $230B in market cap next session (-26%); NASDAQ tumbled 3.7% and social media peers dropped 5-10%.

event_description: ChatGPT public launch by OpenAI, kicking off generative AI investment cycle
outcome_description: MSFT rose 3% over the week on OpenAI ties; NVDA began a 12-month rally that added over $2 trillion in market cap.

event_description: Bank of Japan abandons yield curve control, ending decade of negative interest rate policy
outcome_description: JGB yields rose 5bps; JPY paradoxically weakened past 151 as guidance was dovish; Nikkei held near 40k.

event_description: Bank of Japan tweaks yield curve control cap to 1.0%, signalling policy normalization
outcome_description: USD/JPY spiked above 151 as tweak was seen as insufficient; JGB yields rose to 15-year highs.

event_description: China announces broad stimulus package including rate cuts and property market support
outcome_description: CSI 300 rallied 25% in a week; commodities and China-exposed Western names (LVMH, CAT) gained 3-8%.

event_description: Evergrande China property developer defaults on offshore bonds, triggering property sector crisis
outcome_description: Chinese high-yield property bonds fell 30%; iron ore lost 40% over the following quarter; HSI declined 15%.

event_description: Tesla reports first-ever YoY delivery decline in Q1 2024 amid demand slowdown and price cuts
outcome_description: TSLA fell 5% next session; EV suppliers (Panasonic, ALB) dropped 3-4% on demand concerns.

event_description: Boeing 737 MAX grounded worldwide after second fatal crash within five months
outcome_description: BA fell 11% in three sessions; supplier SPR dropped 8%; airlines with MAX orders declined 3-5%.

event_description: COVID-19 declared global pandemic by WHO, triggering fastest bear market on record
outcome_description: SPX fell 20% in the following seven sessions; VIX peaked above 80; oil, credit, and equities all crashed together.

event_description: US CPI prints 9.1% for June 2022, highest reading since 1981
outcome_description: SPX fell 1% and 2Y yields rose 10bps as market priced 100bps Fed hike; gold sold off despite inflation.
